verdict.rationale: Logseq has an API (a local HTTP server with a single POST /api endpoint that dispatches plugin-API methods), so a downloadable spec is a fair ask. However, the docs explicitly state no OpenAPI document is published. Probes of openapi.json, swagger.json and llms.txt candidate paths all returned 404. The only API documentation is human-readable: docs served by the local server and community-written plugin API docs.
